spatial.subfield_mapping_notes: The ingested 3D asset represents the macroscopic unsegmented right hippocampus (Cornu Ammonis CA1-CA4 + dentate gyrus within one contiguous boundary). Distinct internal subfield parcellation boundaries are not resolved in this macroscopic surface mesh and will be integrated during subsequent subfield segmentation phases.

boundaries.superior: Temporal horn of right lateral ventricle (ventral floor) and amygdaloid complex (anterosuperior)
boundaries.inferior: Subiculum and parahippocampal gyrus (separated by hippocampal fissure)
boundaries.anterior: Amygdaloid complex (separated by uncal recess of temporal horn)
boundaries.posterior: Splenium of corpus callosum, tapering into subsplenial gyrus / indusium griseum
boundaries.medial: Ambient cistern, wing of ambient cistern, and midbrain crus cerebri
boundaries.lateral: Collateral eminence of temporal horn of lateral ventricle

relationships.notes: Right dentate gyrus interlocks with right cornu ammonis.
Located immediately anterosuperior to right hippocampal head.
